# Wild West aged-paper evidence

Two unchanged native1920×1080 failure frames, manually labelled at all28tableau locations and DL. Sources and SHA256 are in labels.json. Both show emptyDR. These are exposed saved-frame regressions, not live acquisition/route proof. No hidden stock or original action trace is inferred.

The complete private calibration bank contains 25 exact crops, selected by the
first visible rank and ink-colour pair on new.png, then old.png. All thirteen
ranks and four suits are represented; no black Ten is visible. The remaining
33 whole cards (26 old, 7 new) are held out from calibration. The singleton
9/black, J/red and Q/red pairs have no independent same-pair heldout.

Warm-paper colour is removed from weak red support. Western component geometry
is measured separately from Classic/Retro; complete components are retained,
without clipping or scaling. Its measured native raster-size allowance is two
pixels after full label competition; Retro retains its one-pixel allowance.
Existing quality and different-label ambiguity bounds remain unchanged.
